name: imf_get_data
description:
Generic access to one IMF series: a database, a country and an indicator code, from the IMF SDMX JSON data service (dataservices.imf.org, no API key).
Returns: database, country_code, indicator_code, frequency, data (period, value) and count; a note when the series is empty.
Inputs (* required): database* (IFS, DOT, BOP, GFSR, FSI, WEO, GFSMAB, CDIS, CPIS, WHDREO); country_code* (ISO 2-letter, e.g. US, JP); indicator_code* (the database's own code, e.g. PCPI_IX in IFS or NGDP_RPCH in WEO); start_year and end_year (1950-2030; omit both for the full history); frequency (A annual, Q quarterly, M monthly; default A).
For named indicators without codes use imf_get_ifs_data or imf_get_weo_data; for balance of payments imf_get_bop_data.
Example: {"database": "IFS", "country_code": "JP", "indicator_code": "PCPI_IX", "start_year": 2015, "end_year": 2024, "frequency": "Q"}

start_year.description: First year, YYYY; if only end_year is given this defaults to 1950

end_year.description: Last year, YYYY; if only start_year is given this defaults to the current year; omit both for the full history

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Generic tool for accessing any IMF database. Use specialized tools like imf_get_ifs_data or imf_get_weo_data for easier access to common indicators.
